research_question: Does accepting Crossref has-preprint relations with asserted-by=object as reciprocal identifier evidence add previously unaudited Nature or Science arXiv candidates in the fixed 2026 window?

result.interpretation: No object-asserted has-preprint target in the complete Crossref Nature/Science window census used id-type=arxiv or the official 10.48550/arXiv DOI namespace. The corrected reciprocal semantics therefore adds zero arXiv candidates in this snapshot. The 137 retained relation entries point to other preprint repositories and are outside this arXiv-and-TeX benchmark scope.

selection_contract.census: Cursor-paginated official Crossref journal-article records for both registered ISSNs of Nature and Science in the inclusive publication-date filter; duplicate ISSN result sets are deduplicated by canonical journal DOI.
selection_contract.relation: Retain only relation.has-preprint entries whose asserted-by value is exactly object.
selection_contract.strict_arxiv_target: Accept only a syntactically valid arXiv identifier in id-type=arxiv or a DOI in the exact 10.48550/arXiv.<arXiv-ID> namespace. DOI and arXiv-ID parsers are separate; malformed nested forms such as 10.48550/arXiv.arXiv:... are rejected.
selection_contract.identity: A retained target must resolve to the same base identifier through the official arXiv Atom API id_list parameter. Search results, title or author similarity, topic similarity, numbers, chemical formulae, and mathematical-symbol normalization are not identity evidence.
selection_contract.doi_conflict: After exact id_list resolution, an explicit arXiv journal DOI different from the Crossref journal DOI is a conflict and cannot be accepted. A missing arXiv journal DOI is not itself a conflict because the Crossref relation is the identifier assertion.
selection_contract.prior_exclusion: Exclude a candidate when either its canonical journal DOI or arXiv base identifier occurs in EXP001-004 frozen sources or a listed prior candidate/linkage audit.
selection_contract.original_research: For candidates remaining after identity and prior exclusions, require an official publisher category establishing original research; Crossref type=journal-article is only a container type.
selection_contract.version: Pin the latest official arXiv version whose update timestamp is no later than the fixed cutoff.
selection_contract.source: Probe only the pinned official arXiv /src endpoint and require at least one strict UTF-8 TeX document.

limitations: Crossref is a live registry. This audit is a metadata snapshot completed on 2026-09-03; later member deposits may change relation coverage even when the publication-date filter is unchanged.

The zero yield applies only to object-asserted has-preprint relations that strictly identify arXiv. It does not imply that the 133 journal articles lack preprints, and it does not measure total journal-to-arXiv recall.
All 137 observed reciprocal targets were DOI identifiers for other preprint repositories. They were excluded by the prespecified arXiv-only scope, not adjudicated as false journal-preprint relations.

Because no strict arXiv target remained, no arXiv id_list call, publisher category request, version selection, or source download was scientifically warranted. Their zero counts are structural zeros, not failed requests.

One excluded Science record has only year-month Crossref publication date-parts. This does not affect the result because its reciprocal target is a non-arXiv DOI and is excluded before date-dependent downstream gates.
Titles are retained only for human-readable reporting. No search result, title, number, chemical formula, or mathematical-symbol normalization contributed to record identity.
This candidate audit does not freeze a cohort and creates no source packet, ScienceCard, or benchmark family.
